mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns, so that the current rate of 2.56% predicts positive returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 2.56%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 300 signals inflationary pressure that leads to monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between FEDFUNDS and UNRATE predicts returns: when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and UNRATE < 3.5%, positive returns are expected over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5 AND UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising employment (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 AND PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The current employment level (PAYEMS = 153018.0 thousand) is high, and high employment predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST above 1500 thousand units signals strong housing demand, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between HOUST and INDPRO predicts returns: when HOUST > 1500 and INDPRO > 104, positive returns are expected over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500 AND INDPRO > 104.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic growth regime (GDPC1 growth > 1% annually), positive S&P 500 forward returns are expected over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 1% annually.
